'''Garnib''' was a large [[Color/Legends|blue]] O-type [[Star/Legends|star]] in the [[Garnib system/Legends|Garnib system]].

==Description==
Garnib was a blue [[Star/Legends#Types of stars|O-type]] main sequence [[Star/Legends|star]].<ref name="TEA" /> Garnib was the primary of the [[Garnib system/Legends|Garnib system]] in the [[Bozhnee sector/Legends|Bozhnee sector]]. It had four orbits, [[Garnib]], [[Hultomo]], [[Mastala]] and [[Coomputu]].<ref name="PoG1" />
